profile.headline: AI Developer Tooling & Enablement at LinkedIn
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer who works on platforms and systems that influence how engineers build, review, and ship software.

Over my career, I have focused on work with broad leverage. This includes developer platforms, design systems, accessibility tooling, and code health and policy enforcement. I am most effective when turning principles into concrete systems, standards, and workflows that hold up across teams and over time.

Today, I work on AI‑assisted development and agent‑based workflows. My focus is helping teams move beyond experimentation by integrating new AI capabilities into real engineering practices, platform constraints, and governance models. This requires careful attention to safety, usability, and long‑term maintainability.

I am drawn to problems at the intersection of developer experience, platform engineering, and organizational standards. I care about building systems where quality, accessibility, and velocity emerge by default through thoughtful design and sustained stewardship.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer · AI Developer Tooling & Enablement
positions.description:
I work on AI‑powered developer tooling and enablement, helping teams adopt agent‑based workflows and AI‑assisted development safely and effectively at scale.

My work spans tool evaluation, rollout, and developer education, integrating AI capabilities into everyday engineering workflows while aligning with security, compliance, and platform requirements.

I partner closely with platform, security, and external tooling teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, reliable developer experiences that teams can trust and use in production.
positions.insights: Generative AI Tools and AI Productivity

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer · Code Health
positions.description:
Owned and evolved internal systems responsible for enforcing code health standards at scale, spanning policy definition, enforcement infrastructure, and developer‑facing workflows.

Worked across policy enforcement, developer experience, accessibility, and compliance, translating engineering requirements into automated, auditable workflows integrated into pull requests, deployments, and internal tooling.

Partnered closely with developer experience, accessibility, security, and platform teams on policy rollout, approvals and exception flows, operational readiness, and long‑term maintainability, balancing enforcement rigor with a practical developer experience.

positions.title: Senior UI Engineer · Accessibility
positions.description:
Built tools and infrastructure to help frontend teams “shift left” on accessibility, enabling issues to be detected and addressed earlier in the development lifecycle.

Focused on empowering UI engineers to build inclusive, accessible experiences by default, while reducing the cognitive and operational burden of accessibility compliance across products.

projects.title: LinkedIn for Small Business Microsite
projects.description: For the first time, LinkedIn has created a site dedicated to educating and guiding small businesses on how to use LinkedIn products for their unique business needs. The site is organized into four primary stages: Personal Branding, Marketing, Selling, and Hiring. Within each stage the small business decision maker can review use case stories, products, and resource materials.

organizations.description: The Pilipino Association of Scientists, Architects, and Engineers (PASAE) serves as a close-knit support group for students in the technical fields, providing student members a space for social interaction, cultural understanding, professional guidance, and academic support.
